newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-SCHMEICHEL TO CAPTAIN DENMARK IN BOSNIA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHMEICHEL TO CAPTAIN DENMARK IN BOSNIA MATCH.

text.p: Manchester United goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel will captain Denmark in their World Cup European group one qualifier against Bosnia in Copenhagen on June 8.
Schmeichel takes over the captaincy from midfielder Michael Laudrup, who sustained a knee injury in April.

Squad: Goalkeepers: Peter Schmeichel (Manchester United), Mogens Krogh (Brondby). Defenders: Jan Heintze (Bayer Leverkusen), Thomas Helveg (Udinese), Jes Hoegh (Fenerbahce), Jacob Laursen (Derby), Marc Rieper (West Ham), Michael Schjoenberg (Kaiserslautern). Midfielders: Morten Bisgaard (Odense), Per Frandsen (Bolton), Allan Nielsen (Tottenham), Brian Steen Nielsen (Odense), Claus Thomsen (Everton), Jon Dahl Tomasson (Newcastle) Strikers: Peter Moeller (Brondby), Brian Laudrup (Glasgow Rangers), Miklos Molnar (Lyngby), Per Pedersen (Blackburn).
